rationale: No existing Streams spec exercises the eBPF traces variant on the Linux host agent or the eBPF instrument variant on the Kubernetes collector. ingestion-config.spec.js covers navigation/copy/content/GPU-card/doc-links on the SAME rich DataSourceSetupCard renderer (reusing selectStepVariant()/getStepCode() helpers in pm.ingestionConfigPage), but its closest test (GPU DCGM Exporter) verifies platform toggles, not the traces/eBPF variants. The feature is its own area with its own source files (content/linux.ts, content/kubernetes.ts, windows.ts, macos.ts) and the run-context names a dedicated spec. A new spec is warranted; it must be registered in ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json under the Streams testfolder.
